name: Molinos Agro S.A.
summary: Molinos Agro S.A. produces and sells soybean meal and oil, and corn in Argentina and internationally. It also provides animal feeds, including pet, poultry, pork, and dairy food products; and constructs and operates a biodiesel plant. In addition, the company exports hipro soy meal, soy hull pellets, crude soy oil, soy lecithin, biodiesel, refined glycerin, and corn wheat. Molinos Agro S.A. is based in Victoria, Argentina.
